command:
set -eu
apk add --no-cache build-base bc bison flex perl openssl-dev elfutils-dev linux-headers xz zstd bash coreutils pahole gmp-dev mpc1-dev mpfr-dev cpio python3 gawk perl-utils diffutils findutils file rsync
{ gcc --version; ld --version; pahole --version; uname -a; df -h /tmp; apk info -vv; } > /out/toolchain.txt
mkdir -m 755 /tmp/profile-input
cp /inputs/seed /tmp/profile-input/apple.config
cp /inputs/linux.tar.xz /tmp/profile-input/linux.tar.xz
cp /inputs/builder /tmp/profile-input/builder
chmod 0444 /tmp/profile-input/*
mkdir /tmp/profile-destination
chown nobody /tmp/profile-destination
su -p -s /bin/sh nobody -c 'id -u; stat -c "%a" /tmp/profile-input/apple.config; sha256sum /tmp/profile-input/apple.config' > /out/builder-user.txt
su -p -s /bin/sh nobody -c 'sh /tmp/profile-input/builder /tmp/profile-input/linux.tar.xz /tmp/profile-input/apple.config /tmp/profile-destination/full full-mthp' > /out/full.log 2>&1 || { tail -30 /out/full.log; exit 1; }
cp -a /tmp/profile-destination/full /out/full
sha256sum /tmp/profile-input/apple.config > /out/seed-after.txt
